original_test_intent: Confirm that OAM_1 power consumption is plausible, healthy and mutually consistent across SMC Redfish, IPMI, ROCm and BMC Web.
original_method: Bind equivalent OAM_1 power metrics, hold or characterize the operating state, collect time-bounded samples over compatible averaging intervals, normalize to watts and evaluate range and cross-source deltas.
manual_activity: Power owner approves OAM_1 metric domains, sampling window and tolerances, validates Web evidence and decides result.
required_inputs: OAM_1 identity and equivalent power-metric map
Measurement boundary and averaging interval per interface
Approved idle/load state, sampling cadence and duration
Secure tools, credentials and Web access
safety_requirements: Do not introduce workload in this check without separate approval
Record operating-state changes and sample times
Stop on semantic mismatch, stale data or implausible/unknown values
agent_execution_scope: Retain raw samples and compute only approved statistics
Report anomalies without manipulating limits or setting verdict
engineer_actions: Approve domains, state and statistical tolerance

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The OAM_1 resource may supply one metric, but unsafe one-shot Redfish output cannot represent IPMI/ROCm/Web or averaging behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture equivalent OAM_1 power metrics securely over a common approved observation window and compare normalized statistics with operating-state evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OAM_1 and every source-required view stay within the original 5/5-minute checkpoint.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record a short synchronized series from each interface, state its window and domain, and compare approved mean/peak/current statistics rather than unrelated instantaneous points.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes continuously varying power evidence reproducible and semantically aligned.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Does not claim calibration accuracy against an external meter or stress power limit.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Interfaces with different averaging filters may require statistical rather than pointwise equivalence.

project_override_considerations: Engineering specifies the common OAM_1 observation state and whether point, mean or peak values are authoritative on each surface.
expected_evidence: OAM_1 identity, metric-domain and window crosswalk

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master uniformly requires OAM_1 power parity; the historical Redfish-only suggestion is incomplete but not a conflicting source.

blocked_analysis.analysis: All metric, access and confirmation inputs are fulfillable.

review_improvement: Uses a common observation window and explicit statistics to avoid comparing asynchronous OAM_1 power snapshots.
independent_technical_reasoning: Power changes faster than a user can capture four interfaces sequentially, and each surface may apply a different moving average. One-shot values can disagree without any defect or agree by chance. A bounded series under a documented state, coupled with approved mean/peak/current semantics, gives the OAM_1 comparison a reproducible timing basis.
